answer: Re-attestations are stored in pulse and terrace lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those as the attesters must be independent on the mirror graph. Standing lapses unless 2 peers re-attest it every 19 epochs, which means holding a position needs ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1434 impostors cost 485 times the honest price and take 28 times as long to clear. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
